name: Kuroenji Nozomi
source:
The Nozomi from the 怨毒の槐 (The "[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Styphnolobium_japonicum]Enju[/url]" of Poisonous Grudge) Chapters.

[spoiler]She's actually Kuroenji Mayumi (黒槐 繭実) switching place with her sister.
When she's unable to (or not willing to) maintain the facade she's voiced by [url=/s83]Aoi Kazuki[/url][/spoiler]
